verdict: Clients stop receiving policy after a site SQL recovery. The `Last Row Version` registry entry on the Policy Provider is higher than the `rowversion` in the recovered site DB, so the provider sees no 'new' rows.
fix: On the primary site server: `Stop-Service SMS_Executive,SiteComp -Force`. Against the recovered DB: `SELECT MIN(rowversion) FROM CI_CIAssignments`. Write that value to `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SMS\Components\SMS_POLICY_PROVIDER Last Row Version` (REG_SZ) on the site server. Do the same for `SMS_OBJECT_REPLICATION_MANAGER`. Restart the two services. Clients get policy again on next cycle.
